description: Editor-approved, source-linked UK public policy milestones and announcements. RSS may include verified notices; calendar includes only future-date events approved for calendar inclusion. Machine candidates require human review.

events.title: Ofgem scheduled energy price cap announcement (Jan–Mar 2027)
events.description: Ofgem says it will announce the cap for 1 January–31 March 2027 by 25 November 2026. It may publish sooner. This is an announcement date, not a payment or personal entitlement.

events.title: Warm Home Discount: deadline to contact helpline if more information is required
events.description: In England and Wales, households asked to provide additional information for the 2026–27 Warm Home Discount must contact the scheme by 26 February 2027. Most eligible people receive the bill credit automatically. This date is not a universal application deadline.

events.title: GOV.UK: £150 Warm Home Discount confirmation letters sent through January 2027
events.description: The UK government's 22 October 2026 announcement says letters are being sent from late October through January 2027. Some households receive the discount automatically; those told to supply extra information must contact the helpline by 26 February 2027. Beware messages requesting bank details. This is a verified public notice, not a personal eligibility decision.
